note: Guesses of the pending outcomes, written down before any of them is known so that they can be scored against what happens. Probabilities are my own judgement, not measurements.

reasons.full size: The test-bed gain of knowledge cells (0.018 to 0.021 trained in windows) fell to 0.008 trained on streams with one seed, the full-size cells start far behind in an already trained stack, and the run is 0.005 behind its reference at 34,500 updates.
reasons.kept cells: Their lead grew from 0.013 to 0.042 over 2,250 updates, but early leads have closed before (depth at equal parameters led 0.026 early and 0.001 at the end).
reasons.stream training: Part of the window-trained gain of knowledge cells was likely help at the cold start of every window, which a stream does not have.
